lane: تلمذ تَلْمَذَ He was, or became, a تِلْمِيذ [or disciple, &c.], لِفُلَانٍ to such a one. (TA, passim.) تلميذ تِلْمِيذٌ A disciple; a pupil; a learner: or a special servant of a teacher: so says 'Abd-El- Kádir El-Baghdádee, who composed a treatise solely on this word: (MF, TA:) or simply a servant; a follower; a dependant: pl. تَلَامِيذُ (L, TA) [and تَلَامِذَةٌ].

entries.text: تلمذ: التلاميذُ: الخَدَمُ والأَتباع، واحدهم تِلْميذٌ.
